races.verdict: POPPYCON has been knocking on the door since switched to handicaps. races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Flat Race
races.verdict: SHUIL SOLAS shaped encouragingly from an unpromising position on her debut at Roscommon (2m) last month and seems sure to build on that opening effort, especially with a more experienced amateur now taking over in the saddle, so she earns the vote. Newcomer Pat O's Rock makes plenty of appeal on paper and needs keeping a close eye on in the betting, while Get It Girl and Royal Tiara are others firmly in the mix. SHUIL SOLAS (IRE) PAT O'S ROCK (IRE) GET IT GIRL (IRE)
